headline: OAK @ BAL matchup research

Batter research is strongest for Shea Langeliers, Nick Kurtz, Jacob Wilson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Taylor Ward, Coby Mayo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
